evidence.reason: At the current tip, chain still builds parent candidates solely by headRef (line 69). The adjacent comment says a parent must not be accepted without proven repository identity, but parents.length === 1 lets a lone fork PR whose head branch name equals the current base become the parent and then satisfy branches.includes via the fork's base. That is an implementation bug in existing intended behavior, not a new hardening requirement; adding the cross-repository flag and filtering it is the minimal repair.
